name: Saucelle (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, white above and ochre yellow below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Saucelle (a willow and a cross of Saint James above waves on white).
history: The arms of Saucelle were approved on 26 March 1993 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 24 January 1994; the municipal flag was approved on 7 April 1995.
